description: The Operations Dashboard gives leadership a real-time view of operational health by measuring fulfillment volume, revenue efficiency, technician productivity, margin performance, and service disruption rates. It is intended to support better decisions around staffing, scheduling, cost control, and execution quality. Other Terms: Ops Dash, Ops Dashboard

The Marketing Dashboard provides a top-of-funnel view of demand generation performance by tracking visibility, traffic, lead volume, and acquisition efficiency across paid and non-paid channels. It measures how effectively marketing spend converts impressions into clicks and clicks into leads, while also separating Google-sourced leads from non-Google leads to show channel mix and dependency. The dashboard is designed to help the team evaluate campaign reach, traffic quality, cost efficiency, and lead acquisition performance so they can optimize spend, improve funnel efficiency, and scale demand more profitably.

The Technician Payroll Dashboard provides visibility into technician compensation, productivity, and payout drivers across the business. It tracks payroll-relevant metrics such as completed jobs, revenue produced, labor hours, commissions, and other compensation components to help ensure payroll accuracy and consistency. The dashboard is designed to help leadership monitor technician earnings, compare output versus pay, identify exceptions or discrepancies, and better understand how technician performance translates into payroll expense.

The KPI Dashboard provides a centralized view of business performance across revenue, demand generation, conversion, and operations. It is designed to help teams monitor core metrics, track trends over time, compare results against targets, and quickly identify areas that need attention. By bringing key performance indicators into a single self-serve interface, the dashboard supports faster decision-making, clearer visibility across functions, and more consistent performance management.

The Technician Leaderboard provides a ranked view of technician performance across key productivity and quality metrics. It helps the team compare technician output, monitor revenue contribution, track utilization, and identify top performers as well as coaching opportunities. The dashboard is designed to create clearer visibility into field performance, encourage accountability, and support decisions around recognition, scheduling, training, and operational improvement.

The Slot Tracker provides a view of appointment capacity versus demand to support supply and demand planning discussions. It helps the team monitor available slots, booked volume, utilization pressure, and capacity gaps across markets and time periods so they can identify where demand is outpacing supply or where unused capacity exists. The dashboard is designed to support faster decisions around staffing, scheduling, market balancing, and operational adjustments during supply and demand meetings.

The Leads Command & Control Dashboard provides a centralized view of lead mix, lead quality, and demand signals across the funnel. It helps the team monitor where leads are coming from, how lead composition is shifting over time, and which customer intents, service categories, and match types are becoming more or less prominent. By surfacing patterns in lead source, urgency, ad group mix, and service-request behavior, the dashboard supports faster decisions around marketing optimization, lead quality management, and demand forecasting.

The Parts Discrepancy Tracking Dashboard provides visibility into gaps between expected and actual parts usage, pricing, billing, or reporting. It helps the team identify discrepancies that may impact job profitability, inventory accuracy, technician execution, or customer billing. The dashboard is designed to surface exceptions quickly so operations and leadership can investigate root causes, reduce leakage, improve process accuracy, and maintain stronger control over parts-related performance.

The Supply & Demand Dashboard provides a consolidated view of demand, available capacity, and operational balance across markets and time periods. It helps the team monitor how booking demand compares to technician supply, slot availability, utilization levels, and service capacity so they can quickly identify where markets are over- or under-capacity. The dashboard is designed to support faster decisions around staffing, schedule adjustments, market balancing, and other operational actions needed to improve service coverage and overall efficiency.

The NuBrakes GBL Dashboard provides a high-level view of GBL channel performance through an Overview tab for core KPI monitoring and a Trends tab for tracking movement over time. It helps leadership quickly assess demand, bookings, cancellations, completions, revenue, and AOV in one place so they can understand overall channel health and spot meaningful changes early. The dashboard is designed to support fast, simple performance reviews and ongoing monitoring of GBL growth, efficiency, and trend direction. Other Terms: GBL Dashboard, GBL Performance Dashboard, GBL Overview Dashboard

The Velocity x NuBrakes Partner Dashboard provides a high-level view of partnership performance through an Overview tab for core KPI monitoring and a Trends tab for tracking performance over time. It helps leadership quickly assess demand, bookings, and completions in one place so they can understand overall partner health and spot meaningful changes early. The dashboard is designed to support simple performance reviews, ongoing partnership monitoring, and faster decisions around growth and optimization. Other Terms: Velocity Dashboard, Velocity Partner Dashboard, Partner Performance Dashboard

The NuBrakes Referral Program Dashboard provides a high-level view of referral performance by tracking actuals versus targets, attainment, pacing, market rankings, and referral trends over time. It helps leadership, market managers, and area managers understand how referral volume is performing across the business while also giving visibility into the referral-to-repair funnel, conversion rates, and estimated revenue impact. The dashboard is designed to support coaching, accountability, and faster decisions to improve referral growth and downstream repair conversion. Other Terms: Referral Dashboard, Referral Program Dashboard, Referral Performance Dashboard

The NuBrakes Cancellation Dashboard provides visibility into job cancellation trends, cancellation reasons, and controllable operational breakdowns across markets, technicians, and time periods. It helps leadership monitor HQ-driven cancellations, customer-driven cancellations, reschedules, cancellation timing, and recurring reason patterns so the team can quickly identify where execution issues or customer friction are affecting completed jobs and revenue. The dashboard is designed to support faster decisions around technician availability, parts readiness, scheduling quality, customer follow-up, and market-level operational improvement. Other Terms: Cancellation Dashboard, Job Cancellation Dashboard, Cancellation Reason Dashboard, HQ Cancellation Dashboard

Other Terms: Velocity Referral Dashboard, NuBrakes Velocity Dashboard, Velocity Referral Program Dashboard, Partner Referral Dashboard
